paper_id: He et al. - 2010 - Why are long-term large-scale wireless sensor networks difficult early experience with GreenOrbs
title: Why Are Long-Term Large-Scale Wireless Sensor Networks Difficult? Early Experience with GreenOrbs
motivation: 现有WSN部署均非长期大规模: ExScal仅存活数日, SensorScope最长6个月但仅97节点
problem_framing: 将WSN长期大规模部署的根本挑战问题化, 通过GreenOrbs早期经验提炼问题
key_insight: 野外环境使诊断/定位/路由问题质变为长期大规模部署的核心障碍
method_signature: GreenOrbs森林传感系统部署经验总结与未来方向讨论
evaluation_criteria: 节点存活数/数据包量/测距误差/流量分布/丢包归因
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 目前没有universal diagnosis tool, 无法定位和彻底解决问题
evidence_for_taste: by far there is no universal diagnosis tool
we can only conjecture the causes
it is in nature difficult to collect all the required information
only 18% nodes have small ranging errors (<1m)
5% nodes carry over 80% of the total traffic
thinking_moves: 从真实部署长期观测数据反推理论假设失效
将定性工程问题(诊断难)归因于资源约束+通信不可靠的本质矛盾
用经验数据量化路由流量不均衡(而非提出新协议)
